in_marathi.name: Kamalesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kamalesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kamal means lotus and Ish means god, thus Kamalesh means the god of lotus. In Hindu mythology, Kamal is the seat of Lord Vishnu and is considered a sacred symbol.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Kamalesh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Kamal means lotus and Ish means god, thus Kamalesh means the god of lotus. In Hindu mythology, Kamal is the seat of Lord Vishnu and is considered a sacred symbol.
